sloka: ततो मांससमायुक्तो वायसः पर्यतुण्डयत् ।तमहं लोष्टमुद्यम्य वारयामि स्म वायसम् ।। ५.३८.१५।।।।
transliteration: tato māṁsasamāyukto vāyasaḥ paryatuṇḍayat ।tamahaṁ loṣṭamudyamya vārayāmi sma vāyasam ।। 5.38.15।।।।

translations.english: 'Then a crow greedy of flesh began to peck my bossom with its beak. I took a clod of earth and warded him off.
